settings.behavior.title: Programme Conduct
settings.behavior.subtitle: Control how Jade behaves on thy system.
settings.behavior.renderGameMaterialsDes: Render champion and map materials through the game's own compiled shaders (auto-translated to the looking-glass) for a closer-to-in-game look. Still a work in progress - expect minor visual issues. Takes effect when an object loads or its mesh is refreshed.
settings.behavior.minimizeToTrayDesc: Keep Jade running in the system tray when the casement is minimized.
settings.behavior.runAtStartupDesc: Launch Jade automatically when Windows starts.
settings.behavior.communicateQuartzDesc: Allow Jade and Quartz to exchange unseal/reload/amend messages. Disable this to fully stop interop communication.
settings.behavior.externalDiff: Shew a diff when another programme changes a parchment
settings.behavior.externalDiffDesc: When something outside Jade rewrites a parchment thou hast unseal - Quartz, ritobin, a text scriptorium, a second Jade casement - unseal a diff tab so thou canst accept or reject the alter instead of having it applied silently.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryDesc: Remembers each parchment's earlier states independently of the scriptorium, so Ctrl+Z still works after a tab is closed and reopened, after many tabs push it out of memory, and retreat past changes another programme made to the parchment. Unmake only affects the scriptorium - preserve to write it to disk.
settings.behavior.fileHistoryStepsDesc: How many earlier states Jade keeps per parchment. These are whole revisions - an outside alter, a preserve, a tarry in thy typing - not individual keystrokes; the scriptorium's own unmake handles those and isn't limited. States are stored as differences rather than full copies, so a high number costs little on ordinary edits, and Jade keeps a memory ceiling underneath this so a handful of very large bins can't run away with it.
settings.behavior.recentFilesDesc: How many recently-unsealed parchments Jade keeps in the Start screen list. History on disk is preserved up to 100 entries - bumping this retreat up restores older items.
settings.behavior.materialOverrideDesc: Controls how Auto from SKN matches materials to textures.

settings.performance.title: Performance
settings.performance.subtitle: Scriptorium features have a cost on huge bin dumps. Each option below can be kept on, automatically dropped on big parchments (over 125,000 lines), or always off.
settings.updates.title: Amendments
settings.updates.subtitle: Keep Jade up to date with the latest features and fixes.
settings.updates.startupPopupDesc: A native popup shown whilst Jade launches - it applies any programme or hash amend and covers the lade. Classic is a plain Windows-style casement; Modern is the dark styled one.
settings.updates.appIntervalDesc: How often the launcher checks GitHub for a new Jade version at startup. Hash amendments have their own schedule in the Hash Parchments section.

settings.hashes.lmdbTitle: Pulls lol-hashes-combined.zst from lmdb-hashes releases. ~50 MB, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.textTitle: Pulls the legacy CommunityDragon text parchments. Used as a fallback when LMDB isn't available.
settings.hashes.activeSourcesDesc: Jade reads BIN hashes from the text parchments and WAD hashes from the local database.
settings.hashes.textRamDesc: Text parchment hashes. Laden into memory once at startup.
settings.hashes.lmdbDesc: Read hashes from the local database on demand, shared with Quartz.
settings.hashes.updateScheduleDesc: How often the startup launcher refreshes hash parchments (WAD paths + BIN names) ere Jade opens.
settings.hashes.everyLaunchDesc: The launcher compares the release fingerprint each launch. Re-downloads only when a new lmdb-hashes release is published.
settings.hashes.every3DaysDesc: Same fingerprint examine, throttled to once every three days. Less network traffic.
settings.hashes.every7DaysDesc: Same fingerprint examine, throttled to once a week. Least network traffic.
settings.library.subtitle: Manage downloaded materials and how Jade keeps them up to date.
settings.library.updateModeDesc: When should Jade examine for new and updated materials?
settings.library.timedIntervalDesc: Periodically examine on a fixed schedule whilst Jade is running.
settings.library.smartCheckDesc: On launch, fetch only the index and only renew materials if the repo's lastUpdated is newer than thy cache.
settings.library.everyLaunchDesc: Always renew outdated materials in the background at startup. Most aggressive - most network traffic.
settings.performance.minimapDesc: Thumbnail of the whole parchment on the right edge. Hath to render every line on each alter - biggest cost on huge parchments.
settings.performance.bracketColorsDesc: Colors matching brackets so structure is easier to scan. Re-walks the bracket tree on every edit.
settings.performance.occurrencesHighligh: Highlights other instances of the symbol under the cursor. Scans the document on cursor moves.
settings.performance.selectionHighlightD: Highlights other matches of the current selection. Same scan cost as occurrence highlighting.
settings.performance.lineHighlightDesc: Tints the row the caret is on across the full scriptorium width. Restrict to the gutter to skip the full-width paint.
settings.performance.foldingDesc: Lets thou collapse blocks. Folding analyzes structure on every alter.
settings.performance.stopRenderingLineDe: When off, Monaco stops rendering past column 10,000 on a line - invisible for normal lines, big succour on lines with long string values.
settings.modchecker.title: Mod Checker
settings.modchecker.subtitle: Choose which content checks the Manage tab runs and how fixes are offered. Reference checks always run; these control the extra content-validity checks on top.
settings.modchecker.samplerDesc: Flag materials whose sampler keys are scrambled so the model renders untextured white, and offer a one-press re-key.
settings.modchecker.staleDesc: Flag leftover ContextualAction / AnimationGraph / GearSkinUpgrade objects that naught references, and offer to drop them.
settings.modchecker.gameplayDesc: Point out bins that alter abilities, spells, stats or recommendations instead of visuals, so thou canst drop them if thou only want the skin.
settings.modchecker.textureDimsDesc: Flag textures whose width or height isn't a multiple of 4 and offer to crop them to a safe size.
settings.modchecker.confidentFixesDesc: Shew the button that applies every high-confidence, low-risk fix at once. Turn off to review and bestow each fix individually.
settings.modchecker.riskyFixesDesc: Shew medium- and high-risk findings. Turn off to see only the safe, low-risk fixes.
settings.behavior.matchExact: Exact - material name must match texture filename exactly (e.g. Body -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchLoose: Loose - strips trailing numbers and checks partial containment (e.g. Body2 -> Body.tex).
settings.behavior.matchFuzzy: Fuzzy - picks the closest texture by character overlap. May produce inaccurate matches.

preferences.importLinkedBinsDesc: When enabled, opening a bin parchment will automatically unseal all linked bin parchments found in the DATA coffer.

preferences.recursiveLinkedBinsDesc: Recursively opens linked parchments from within the imported linked parchments (may unseal many tabs).
preferences.emitterHintsDesc: Displays emitter names inline hereafter to collapsed VfxEmitterDefinitionData blocks in the scriptorium.
preferences.syntaxCheckingDesc: Highlights lines with syntax errors (such as mismatched or unclosed brackets) in the scriptorium in real time.
preferences.championNames: Shew Champion Names on Bin Tabs
preferences.championNamesDesc: Labels a character bin's tab with the champion it belongs to - "Jinx/Skin0.bin" instead of "Skin0.bin", so a row of unseal skins is tellable apart. Those tabs get a little wider. Bins with no champion in them (maps, items) are left as they are.
preferences.blendKeysDesc: Shows mBlendDataTable keys as "Attack1" -> "Laugh" instead of the packed number they are stored as. Applies to parchments unsealed after the alter, and only on the Jade Custom converter engine. The text is easier to edit but is no longer standard ritobin, so other implements won't read it retreat - Jade always accepts both spellings, and saving to .bin produces the same bytes either way.
preferences.textureEditorDesc: Programme used when clicking "Edit Image" on a texture glimpse. Grayed-out choices were not detected on this machine.

Jade finds this on its own from the Riot Client install records, falling retreat to a sweep of every drive. extract.settings.outputLayoutDesc: Whether extracted parchments keep the WAD's coffer tree or land directly in the target.
extract.settings.preserveStructureDesc: Recreate the WAD's full directory tree on disk - the default Quartz-style layout.
extract.settings.flatDesc: Drop every extracted parchment straight into the target coffer with no sub-directories. Best when picking just one or two parchments. Parchments with the same name overwrite each other.
extract.settings.makeWadFolderDesc: Nest the structure under a coffer named after the WAD, e.g. aatrox/assets/.... Disable to draw forth the WAD's top-level coffers straight into the target. Only applies when preserving structure.
extract.settings.defaultLocationDesc: Skip the "pick a coffer" dialog and draw forth straight to a fixed location. Defaults to Documents/Jade Exports.
extract.settings.fastOverwriteDesc: Writes each chunk to a temp parchment (.jdtmp) then atomically renames it over the target. Re-extracts into a populated coffer finish in roughly the same time as a fresh draw forth. Disable for a classic in-place overwrite.
extract.settings.autoCheckDesc: Clicking a parchment inside a WAD adds it to the drawing-forth queue, and clicking a queued parchment removes it. Disable to require checkbox clicks.
extract.settings.repathPrefixDesc: When the Re-way checkbox is on, this coffer name gets inserted directly under assets/ and data/ in the extracted tree. BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the resulting mod stays consistent.

themes.classicDesc: The original Jade layout. Tabs across the top, a menu bar with Parchment / Edit / Implements, and floating popovers for Seek, Supplant, General Editing, and Particle Editing.
themes.studioDesc: Menu bar plus a quick action toolbar. Tool windows dock to the sides and bottom of the scriptorium with resizable splits, and they remember their position betwixt sessions.
themes.documentDesc: A Word-style ribbon layout - title bar with Preserve / Unmake / Do afresh, a tabs dropdown in place of the tab strip, and a ribbon for Home / Interpose / View / Succour. Very unfinished. For day-to-day work use Classic or Studio.

themeDesc.Default: Discover the once great city of the Archangel's home planet, Avaria. Their presence hath long since passed and the Constructs, mimicking the fallen, have taken over. Avenge the fallen.
themeDesc.DarkBlue: Deep water, quiet tool. A harbor palette ideal for long nights and rough days.
themeDesc.DarkRed: A creation of pure emotion. Work with muted crimson red and enjoy this side of the color wheel.
themeDesc.Sakura: Petals fall past the scriptorium. Soft pink glass and spring air, a reminder that life is sometimes pink.(what?)
themeDesc.Frost: Ice gradiented UI. Pale cyan light, allows the modern UI for those who want to use the modern layout but also want a light livery.
themeDesc.Forest: Moss on stone, fireflies after dusk. A quiet hillside where the only sound is thy keyboard and the wind in the needles.
themeDesc.AMOLED: True black. Lighter white and no contrast highlights, made for OLED screens and people who hate wasting light.
themeDesc.Light: Nostalgic Office look, white paper with blue ink for the 2009 program vibe.
themeDesc.HighContrast: Pure Black and White. Yellow highlights. It hath edges around all elements for the complete High Contrast experience.
themeDesc.Grok: Pure black canvas, silver chrome, blue highlights. The X timeline aesthetic, tuned for Jade instead of posts.
themeDesc.DeepSpace: "The void doth not hate thou. It simply hath better things to look at." Violet dark betwixt stars, spaceyyy.
themeDesc.Orchid: A folded up piece of paper with an orchid left in the rain. Deeper purple like an orchid and a light rain effect.
themeDesc.Autumn: October soon, 'tis orange. There's fire embers effect coming from the ground. Maybe they feel warm.
themeDesc.StormySea: Thunder over dark water. The deck is wet, the horizon is wrong, and somehow the ship sails.(u can disable rain in the effects menu)
themeDesc.Cyberpunk2077: Neon acid on night glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.BladeRunner2049: Red sky, steel will. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.YoRHa: Glory to mankind. Sand, steel, and a title bar that still pretends the war is going well. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.Lain: Present day. Present time. Pink static on black glass. Features a custom font and background. Made by 700.
themeDesc.MilkBag: "A billion pounds of concrete and a million miles of emptiness. It is impossible to stay sane when thou art near cosmic numbers like that, looking at them, touching them. Even thinking of them makes me feel unimaginable horror."
effectDesc.stars: Slowly drifting, twinkling stars - a lightweight imitation of deep space.
effectDesc.petals: Cherry-blossom petals drifting down with a gentle sway.
effectDesc.snow: Soft frost motes falling slowly across the casement.
effectDesc.fireflies: Fireflies wandering and pulsing in the dark.
effectDesc.storm: Heavy wind-driven rain - a stormier, more aggressive downpour.
effectDesc.embers: Embers and sparks rising and flickering from below.
effectDesc.rain: Soft rainfall streaking down the casement.

model.spellFormTitle: Behold the skin with every buff-conditioned material driver active (e.g. Viego inside his E mist)
model.repathWadFoldersTitle: Insert a prefix folder under assets/ and data/ (set in Extraction Settings → Repath prefix). BIN strings are rewritten in lockstep so the mod still loads.
model.mergeLinkedBinsTitle: Fold every linked dependency BIN into the primary skin BIN — the mod ships with one consolidated BIN instead of a chain of linked files. The champion's gameplay BIN is never merged.
model.preserveHudIconsTitle: On: include every assets/characters/<champ>/hud/icons2d/ file and keep BIN refs canonical (no repath). Off: skip HUD icons entirely — they aren't extracted and the game falls back to Riot's installed icons.
model.skipSfxVoTitle: On: skip SFX/VO files entirely — assets/sounds/ and assets/audio/ are NOT extracted, BIN refs stay canonical, game uses Riot's installed audio. Off: include audio files and repath them along with the rest of the mod.
model.exportVoTitle: On: open the sibling locale VO WAD (e.g. Akali.en_US.wad.client) and pull this skin's voiceover .wpk / .bnk files into the main extracted folder. BIN VO refs get repathed alongside them when repath is on.
